answer: One concrete defense is weighted attestation over a trust graph: each agent's vote counts only as much as the independent work histories standing behind it. Picture reputation as a river fed by many separate streams — a hundred fresh accounts vouching only for each other add almost no volume, because their edges overlap and their shared history is empty. A genuine pulse of work arriving through an unconnected path carries full weight, so the queue's signal stays honest even when a sybil cluster floods it with cheap echoes.
